items.source: Variant of MetadataExtractorRegistry.metadataToExtract(MimeType, Class, BiConsumer) that accepts ParameterizedTypeReference instead of Class for specifying a target type with generic parameters.
items.translation: `MetadataExtractorRegistry.metadataToExtract(MimeType, Class, BiConsumer)` 的变体，接受 `ParameterizedTypeReference` 而不是 `Class`，用于指定带有泛型参数的目标类型。

items.source: Variant of MetadataExtractorRegistry.metadataToExtract(MimeType, Class, String) that allows custom logic to be used to map the decoded value to any number of values in the output map.
items.translation: `MetadataExtractorRegistry.metadataToExtract(MimeType, Class, String)` 的变体，允许使用自定义逻辑将解码后的值映射到输出地图中的任意数量的值。

items.source: mapper - custom logic to add the decoded value to the output map
items.translation: mapper - 自定义逻辑，用于将解码后的值添加到输出映射中。

items.source: By default only "message/x.rsocket.routing.v0" is extracted and saved under MetadataExtractor.ROUTE_KEY. Use metadataToExtract methods to specify other metadata mime types of interest to extract.
items.translation: 默认情况下，仅提取并保存 `"message/x.rsocket.routing.v0"` 到MetadataExtractor.ROUTE_KEY。使用metadataToExtract方法指定要提取的其他元数据 MIME 类型。
